services.subtitle: Our Specializations
services.title: Comprehensive Orthodontic Services
services.pediatric.title: Pediatric Orthodontics
services.pediatric.desc: Early evaluation and treatment for children. We monitor jaw growth and development, using interceptive techniques to guide teeth into proper alignment from a young age.
services.braces.title: Metal Braces
services.braces.desc: Traditional metal braces remain the most effective solution for complex orthodontic cases. Modern brackets are smaller, more comfortable, and work faster than ever before.
services.ceramic.title: Ceramic Braces
services.ceramic.desc: Tooth-colored ceramic brackets offer a discreet alternative to metal braces. They blend naturally with your teeth while providing the same effective treatment results.
services.aligners.title: Clear Aligners
services.aligners.desc: Nearly invisible removable aligners that straighten teeth without brackets or wires. Perfect for adults and teens who want a discreet treatment option with maximum comfort.
services.splints.title: Orthodontic Splints
services.splints.desc: Custom-made splints for TMJ disorders, bruxism, and bite correction. We design precise appliances to relieve jaw pain and protect your teeth from grinding damage.
services.lingual.title: Lingual Braces
services.lingual.desc: Braces placed behind the teeth for completely invisible treatment. Ideal for professionals and anyone who wants effective orthodontic care without visible appliances.
services.retainers.title: Retainers & Maintenance
services.retainers.desc: Post-treatment retainers to maintain your new smile for life. We offer both fixed and removable options with regular follow-up care to ensure lasting results.
services.digital.title: Digital Treatment Planning
services.digital.desc: 3D scanning, digital X-rays, and computer-simulated treatment outcomes. See your future smile before treatment begins with our state-of-the-art imaging technology.
services.jaw.title: Jaw Correction (Orthognathic)
services.jaw.desc: Comprehensive treatment for jaw misalignment and skeletal discrepancies. We work with oral surgeons to plan and execute complex cases for optimal functional and aesthetic outcomes.
